'''''Questor''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] aboard ''Questor'' in the aftermath of his capture of the [[Whiplash]] resistance leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], to pick up equipment on the world that could be used to [[Prison/Legends|imprison]] and interrogate Yimmon.
